hooks.prompt: Check if any content files (HTML, markdown, .astro, .mdx, PHP, JS with JSX) were created or modified this session. If yes: (1) run /semantic-audit on each file and iterate improvements until score >=85, logging results to results.tsv. (2) If a URL was deployed, use puppeteer MCP to navigate to it, check for console errors via puppeteer_evaluate, and take a screenshot. Only confirm completion after both checks pass. Skip if session only involved config changes, git operations, or MCP setup with no content/code output.
